name: 8-BitRyan
biography: Ryan (last name unknown), better known online as 8-BitRyan, is a British content creator who's well known for his videos of Five Nights at Freddy's, and other horror games. Due to his popularity, Ryan would receive cameos in the live action Five Nights at Freddy's movies, being an employee of the month poster in the first and a physical appearance as a carnival attendee in the second.
